Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1861. Join assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, molecule_dictionary on molregno, and compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
